name: What is the process for exterior door installation with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for exterior door installation with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our exterior door installation process begins with a detailed consultation to understand your vision and assess your current needs. Following this, we develop a comprehensive plan, which may include CAD-supported layouts for complex entries, and assist with material selection. Once design and materials are finalized, our skilled craftsmen handle demolition, frame preparation, door installation, trim work, and ensure a precise, weather-tight seal. We manage all aspects, including permit coordination if necessary, providing a single point of coordination from planning to final walkthrough, characteristic of our design-build approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, detailed planning, material selection, professional installation, and trim work, all managed by our team from start to finish.
